description.narrative: (Zambia): Local Impact Governance supports the Government of the Republic of Zambia (GRZ) to strengthen participatory governance and the fiscal capabilities of local authorities for improved development planning, implementation, and performance management. With FY 2022 funds, the activity will: 1) help citizens and the private sector improve their collective skills to assess service delivery and constructively engage with government; 2) strengthen the sub-national governance system to become more responsive to citizen needs, generate revenue, and improve service-delivery outcomes; and 3) generate learning and facilitate problem solving that supports an effective, financially viable sub-national governance system. At the national Level, Local Impact will support the review of the Decentralization Policy to align it with the 2016 Constitution and the new Administration's priorities. The activity will also support the Government of Zambia to kick start sector devolution which is a key enabling approach for national decentralization of service delivery for key district services which are scheduled to be devolved within the next two years. Under USAID/Zambia's Country Development Cooperation Strategy, the activity will support Development Objective 1: Citizen and National Self-Reliance Advanced by More Effective Accountable Governance and IR 1.1 Citizen Engagement in National Development Choices Strengthened and contributes and contributes to IR 1.2 Public Resources more Effectively Used.....
